final_topology.title: Government Secure Network
final_topology.description: Connect main data center to regional and branch offices with secure internet and remote access.
final_topology.topology_summary: The main data center will be connected to regional and branch offices via a dedicated WAN. A secure internet perimeter with email and web filtering will be implemented, along with remote access capabilities.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various zones and nodes, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to relevant zones and nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes data flow links, but there is no explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant zones and nodes.

findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a DNS filtering service and links to relevant zones and nodes.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
